description: COMPOSITE. Finds the latest GitHub deployment/release for a repo, then queries Sentry for unresolved issues SINCE that deploy's timestamp (the deploy time drives the Sentry window), then looks up who's currently on-call in PagerDuty — and synthesizes one situational-awareness object. Degrades gracefully: if Sentry or PagerDuty creds are absent it returns what it can plus a note. GitHub is required (it's the anchor).

environment.description: Filter GitHub deployments and Sentry issues to this environment, e.g. 'production'.

sentry_project.description: Sentry project slug/id. Falls back to SENTRY_PROJECT env if omitted.

name: whats_broken_since_last_deploy
title: What's broken since the last deploy?
